next.reason: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 restates the equivalence: 'MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1 ... according to the rules specified for the MOVE statement', then 'The same WRITE statement without the FROM phrase'. Its added 'MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1' serves FROM literal-1, syntax a 1985 program cannot contain (the 1985 format allows only identifier-1), so no 1985 program changes meaning; the new form belongs to the format's record. NOTE 1 on overlap concerns operands 1985 SR VII.4.7.3-1 refused, which is that rule's change.
